Directions: SAT NAV Post Code LA22 0BU From the south – A 591 towards Ambleside. Turn left at the traffic lights (Waterhead) onto Borrans Road. Enter the one way system – keep in left hand lane and follow the one way system left up Compston Road - now take the right hand lane and at the ‘T’ junc turn right into Rydal Road (still one-way) ** follow (100 yds) and take the first turning on the right into Church Street. The Priest Hole is just set back from the junction on the right. For off street parking : continue down Church Street and turn left at the bottom – short stay (up to 4hrs) car park on left. For long stay continue passed short stay and turn right and then after 20 yds right again into car park.
